rationale: Builds on the closest kill rsi_meanrev(period=14, entry=30, exit=70), which posted the only above-incumbent median fold Sharpe (2.26 vs incumbent 1.85) and beat the benchmark in 2/4 folds but was killed for only 14 trades in folds (<30) and deflated-Sharpe prob 0.13. Shortening the RSI period from 14 to 5 (adjacent ladder rung) makes RSI cross the same entry=30 threshold far more often while keeping the entry/exit logic that produced the high fold Sharpe, directly addressing the trade-count failure that killed the original.

Builds on the closest kill rsi_meanrev(period=14, entry=30, exit=70), killed for only 14 trades (<30) and deflated-Sharpe prob 0.13 despite a median fold Sharpe of 2.26 above the incumbent's 1.85. Raising the entry threshold one ladder rung from 30 to 35 widens the oversold trigger so the same period=14 signal fires more frequently, directly targeting the insufficient-trades kill reason without changing the exit rule that shaped its fold returns.

Builds on the closest kill rsi_meanrev(period=14, entry=30, exit=70), killed for only 14 trades (<30) and deflated-Sharpe prob 0.13 despite a median fold Sharpe of 2.26. Lowering the exit from 70 to 60 (adjacent ladder rung) closes positions earlier on a weaker overbought signal, freeing capital to re-enter on the next oversold dip and so increasing trade count, which is the exact failure that killed the original rather than its Sharpe.

Builds on both rsi_meanrev(period=2) trials, which had ample trades (141 for entry=10 and 163 for entry=30) and positive Sharpe in all four folds for entry=10, but were killed for median fold Sharpe of only 1.00/0.98 (<= incumbent 1.85), beating the benchmark in just 1/4 folds, and deflated-Sharpe prob 0.26/0.08; it also builds on the period=14/entry=30 kill whose median Sharpe was 2.26 but which had only 14 trades. Period=3 with the intermediate entry=20 is the untested middle ground between the too-noisy period=2 and the too-sparse period=14, aiming to keep period=2-level trade count while lifting median fold Sharpe toward the period=14 result.
